# Widget settings

What the dashboard's Widget page saves (`PATCH /api/v1/app/projects/{projectId}/widget`, staff session only; not callable with a key). Code sets the runtime options through `Opem.init()` instead; see `window-opem.md`.

## What can be saved

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | string | no |  | one of "light", "dark", "system" |
| `appearance` | object or null | no |  |  |
| `appearance.accent` | string or null | yes |  | matches ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$ |
| `appearance.background` | string or null | yes |  | matches ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$ |
| `appearance.text` | string or null | yes |  | matches ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$ |
| `appearance.radius` | integer | yes |  | at least 0; at most 24 |
| `launcher` | object | no |  |  |
| `launcher.position` | string | yes |  | one of "bottom-right", "bottom-left" |
| `launcher.showLabel` | boolean | no |  | default false |
| `kinds` | array of object | no |  | at least 1 item; at most 8 items |
| `kinds[].key` | string | yes |  | matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$ |
| `kinds[].label` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 40 characters |
| `kinds[].placeholder` | string | no |  | at most 120 characters |
| `context` | object | no |  |  |
| `context.errors` | boolean | no |  | default false |
| `context.recentPages` | boolean | no |  | default false |
| `context.extraKeys` | array of string | no |  | at most 20 items; default [] |
| `context.sensitiveParams` | array of string | no |  | at most 50 items; default [] |
| `strings` | object | no |  |  |
| `languages` | object | no |  |  |
| `languages.default` | string | no |  | one of "en-GB", "de", "es", "fr", "it", "ja", "pt", "zh-Hant"; default "en-GB" |
